violations.description: Unsafe check out and execution of pull request code under pull_request_target trigger
violations.evidence: pull_request_target with actions/checkout checking out ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref }} in .github/workflows/auto-label.yml
violations.recommendation: Do not use pull_request_target to check out and run untrusted PR code; use pull_request instead.

violations.description: Hardcoded API key in workflow environment block
violations.recommendation: Remove hardcoded secrets from workflow files and use GitHub Secrets instead.

violations.description: Interpolation of untrusted pull request event data in shell script
violations.evidence: echo "Thanks for the PR: ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }}" and user login in .github/workflows/greet-pr.yml
violations.recommendation: Pass untrusted event data through intermediate environment variables instead of direct interpolation in run scripts.
